title: Indexed Logarithmic Cartier Transform
summary: This article is the third of a series of three articles whose goal is to generalize the Cartier transform of Ogus and Vologodsky to the logarithmic setting. In the second one, we generalized a topos-theoretic version of this transform, due to Oyama. Let $W$ be the ring of Witt vectors of a perfect field of positive characteristic $p$ and equip $\operatorname{Spf}W$ with the trivial log structure.
